statement: Checksummed self-describing packages provide a simple integrity boundary for transfer/backup.
actakit_implication: Prefer BagIt-like package manifests for export/backup before inventing federation packages.

statement: Even a small transfer standard accumulated cross-implementation path-encoding divergence around percent signs.
actakit_implication: Treat package validation/version compatibility as real tests; never assume manifest conformance from library name alone.

statement: Bag integrity checks detect accidental corruption but do not by themselves provide authenticity against an active attacker.
actakit_implication: Use hashes for integrity; do not imply cryptographic signer authenticity unless separately implemented.
